charts.title: How the sampling floor was sized by simulation.
charts.takeaway: Simulated people whose mood relaxes in 5, 15 or 30 minutes were fitted at the floor or as noise in 89, 98 and 89 percent of runs, against a bar of 90 percent, so the prediction missed at two of three values.
charts.n: 100 simulated people for each of 7 true time constants; five prompts a day for 20 days, no measurement noise

steps.label: Planted: a known time constant
steps.detail: Each simulated mood relaxes toward its mean with a time constant set by us, from 5 minutes to 48 hours.

steps.label: The same fit as on real people
steps.detail: A time constant and a noise share are fitted to the five-a-day prompts. A fit is at the floor when the time constant is shorter than the gap between prompts.

steps.label: Rule: 90 percent at the floor or as noise
steps.detail: For true time constants of 5, 15 and 30 minutes, at least 90 percent of runs had to be fitted at the floor or with a noise share of 0.8 or more.

steps.label: 89, 98 and 89 percent
steps.detail: Two of the three values fell one run short. At a true time constant of 3 hours the share is 22 percent, and at 12 and 48 hours it is 0.

charts.title: Simulated people fitted at the sampling floor or as noise, by how fast their mood really changes.
charts.takeaway: With five prompts a day, mood that turns over in an hour or less is read as noise about 9 times in 10; at 3 hours the share falls to 22 percent.
charts.units: percent of 100 simulated people fitted at the sampling floor or with a noise share of 0.8 or more
charts.n: 100 simulated people for each true time constant; five prompts a day for 20 days
charts.no_interval: The result file holds one share per time constant from 100 runs, with no interval.
charts.baseline: A schedule that could see the process would put no simulated person at the floor, as at 12 and 48 hours
charts.threshold: Preregistered bar: 90 percent or more at 5, 15 and 30 minutes

axis.label: simulated people at the floor or read as noise (percent)

columns: At the floor or as noise (%)
